title: Output extends the initial output
statement: For any machine $H$ with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $B$, any configuration $c$, and any $t\in\mathbb N$, there is a finite word $o$ such that the output after $t$ steps is the initial output of $c$ followed by $o$.
hypotheses_covered: Machine $H$ with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $B$
